Description: "Improve _profit_color and _chip functions to support modern dark tech aesthetics, including semi-transparent backgrounds and rounded border radiuses."
Instruction: "Update `_profit_color` to use modern green/red hex codes and add `bg_color` support to `_chip` with a border radius of 12."
ReplacementContent:
"    def _profit_color(self, value):
        return "#10b981" if value >= 0 else "#f43f5e"

    def _chip(self, text, color, bg_color=None):
        bgcolor = bg_color if bg_color else "#1a222c"
        border_color = color if bg_color else "#2a313a"
        return ft.Container(
            content=ft.Text(text, size=10, color=color, weight=ft.FontWeight.W_600),
            padding=ft.padding.symmetric(horizontal=8, vertical=2),
            bgcolor=bgcolor,
            border_radius=12,
            border=ft.border.all(1, border_color),
        )"
